local.title: Local business
local.description: For businesses that serve a place: a shop, clinic, firm or trade with an address or a service area.

agents.seo-local-agent: Use the seo-local-agent to check the business profile, listings consistency, local markup and location pages.
agents.seo-local-gbp-optimizer: Use the seo-local-gbp-optimizer to audit the Google Business Profile against the site: categories, services, hours, posts, Q&A and photos. It produces an action plan for a person.
agents.seo-local-citation-auditor: Use the seo-local-citation-auditor to check that name, address and phone match across the site, its markup and the main directories, and list the fixes.
agents.seo-local-content-writer: Use the seo-local-content-writer for location and service-area pages: unique local substance, never one template with the town name swapped.
agents.seo-local-ai-visibility: Use the seo-local-ai-visibility agent to check how AI answers name the business for local questions, and what would make it citable.
agents.seo-local-review-manager: Use the seo-local-review-manager to plan honest review requests and replies. Never write or buy reviews.

ecommerce.title: Online shop
ecommerce.description: For sites that sell products: catalogues, carts and product pages.

agents.seo-ecommerce: Use the seo-ecommerce agent on category, product and faceted-navigation pages: product markup, crawl traps, out-of-stock handling and duplicate categories.
